dedupe_keys.name: installations de production de la filiere solaire par commune

description: Installations de production de la filière "Solaire" par commune is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gestionnaires de Réseaux Electricité et Gaz. Ce jeu de données est une synthèse du nombre d'installations de la filière "Solaire" par commune tout niveau de tension confondu, en exploitation et en projet. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are energies solaires, environnement, soleil, production energie renouvelable. The portal shows 1,487 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
